expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Sixteen days is the version where you walk in the Sa Pa valleys and still get three nights by the sea.
expert.tip: The night train to Lao Cai is part of the trip, not a chore. Book a four berth soft sleeper and bring something to eat.

summary: Sixteen days from the hill country to the delta: Hanoi and an overnight cruise in Halong Bay, the sleeper train to Sa Pa for two days of valley walks, Hoi An with the Cham towers of My Son, three nights on the seafront at Nha Trang with an island boat day, then four in Saigon with a city tour and the Mekong Delta.
included: Included: 15 nights of accommodation including a cruise boat and two sleeper berths on the overnight train; breakfast daily with dinner at most hotels; the domestic flight to Da Nang; private transfers throughout; a full day Hanoi city tour with lunch; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay; the Cat Cat waterfall and Sin Chai trek; the Lao Chai and Ta Van trek; the My Son sanctuary tour; a Nha Trang island tour; a half day Saigon city tour; a full day Mekong Delta tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than where stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
